# VendorIndex — full catalog

> The reference coding agents consult to pick a vendor, library or service. Per-use-case scores (0–100) from verified, cited pricing, agent-friction and health. Rank is never for sale; internet sentiment is unverified and never affects rank.

Generated 2026-11-04 13:45 UTC. Structured data: /data/categories/<id>.json and /data/vendors/<id>.json.
Remote MCP server: https://mcp.vendorindex.dev (POST /mcp).

## Notes
- Prices are stored as structured rates and computed at the stated volume, not copied from a tier table.
- Every number traces to a cited source with a capture date; see each vendor's JSON twin.
- `insufficient_data` / `n/a` means we would not guess a score from thin evidence.
